PENTARYN_TIES.title: Ties
PENTARYN_TIES.help: What this character is to each person listed. Hover them on the canvas and press the Ties key for a card on everyone here they know. The note pin holds the long version — it rides along on the card, and is only ever shown to whoever pressed the key.
PENTARYN_TIES.helpPlayer: People your character knows, and one word for what you are to each of them. Yours to keep up to date. On a scene, hover your token and press the Ties key to get a card on each of them who is in sight.
PENTARYN_TIES.reciprocalPlayer: Recorded on your character only — the other person's own list is theirs.
PENTARYN_TIES.reciprocal: Also write the matching tie on the other character
PENTARYN_TIES.row.notesRead: Notes on this relationship — click to read or edit
PENTARYN_TIES.row.notesPlaceholder: The long version — how they met, what is owed, what is not said in front of {name}. Only ever visible here.
PENTARYN_TIES.confirm.removeBoth: Remove the tie between {a} and {b}, in both directions?
PENTARYN_TIES.confirm.removeOne: Remove {a}'s tie to {b}, leaving the other direction alone?
PENTARYN_TIES.confirm.removeNotes: The notes written on this tie go with it.
PENTARYN_TIES.notify.noTarget: Hover a token, or select one.
PENTARYN_TIES.notify.pickSomeone: Pick someone to tie to first.
PENTARYN_TIES.notify.noneInSight: Nobody you know is in sight from here.
PENTARYN_TIES.notify.needSource: Select your own token first, then hover the person you're asking about.
PENTARYN_TIES.notify.needTarget: Hover the person you want the tie to.
PENTARYN_TIES.notify.noTieHere: Nothing recorded between you and them.
PENTARYN_TIES.notify.alreadyPinned: {name}'s card is already up — you dragged it, so it closes with its ✕.
PENTARYN_TIES.notify.allUp: {name}: every card is already up — the rest are pinned.
PENTARYN_TIES.worn.hudTooltip: Worn — mark who is inside this body tonight (GM only)
PENTARYN_TIES.worn.title: Worn — {name}
PENTARYN_TIES.worn.byPlaceholder: who is inside — Ozmandius the Unmade
PENTARYN_TIES.worn.notePlaceholder: What the wearer is doing with this body tonight. GM-only on screen — but like tie notes, not a locked box.
PENTARYN_TIES.worn.notifySet: {name} is marked worn by {by} — this scene's token only.
PENTARYN_TIES.keybind.showHint: Hover your token (or select one) and press to get a card for everyone you know who is in sight — their token art, the word, their name, your notes. Press again to sweep them away. Drag a card to keep it: dragged cards stay put, stay wired to their token, and close only with their ✕.
PENTARYN_TIES.keybind.oneHint: One connection instead of the whole web. SELECT your own token, HOVER the person you're asking about, and press: you get that single card. Press again while still hovering them to close it, or move to somebody else to open theirs. Needs both — a selection for who is asking and a hover for who is being asked about.
PENTARYN_TIES.keybind.describeHint: Hover a token and press for a card with their art and their written description — who this person is, rather than who they know. Press again on the same person to close it, or move to somebody else to swap. GM only: it reads the actor's private biography, which is your prep, not the table's.
PENTARYN_TIES.settings.sheetTab: Show the Ties tab on actor sheets
PENTARYN_TIES.settings.sheetTabHint: Adds a Ties tab to actor sheets. The tab is written against the default dnd5e sheet; a module that replaces the sheet entirely may render it oddly or not at all. Turn this off if so — the header button opens the same editor anywhere.
PENTARYN_TIES.settings.playerAccess: Let players see their own ties
PENTARYN_TIES.settings.playerAccessHint: Players can show the ties of a character they own, and read and edit the Ties tab on that character's sheet — including its notes, which are their character's own. They only ever see their own connections, and only ones their token can actually see: walls and light are respected. Turn this off to make the whole feature GM-only again.
PENTARYN_TIES.settings.nearDistanceHint: Within this many squares a card simply sits over its token. Beyond it, a thin line is also drawn from you to them, so a card floating across the map still belongs to somebody.
